visualReview.notes: Principal connected Boyana Church exterior: stone western annex, taller brick middle body with raised south doorway and supported exterior stair/landing/rails, lower eastern church with curved roof crown and rounded brick apse/slit window, blind brick arcades and octagonal plaster drum/tiled cap/cross. Upper door is an actual 0.35m recess with jambs, soffit and threshold. Corrected the missing apse, dark upper door and metric brick UV consistency and closed roof/eave undersides during the same author/inspect/fix pass. Arcades and small windows are closed exterior proxies, not traversable openings.

sharedSurfaceReview.notes: Six existing 256px shared graphs and six roles: brick, stone_drywall, plaster_lime, tile_ceramic, wood_plain and metal_painted. Metric UVs: brick 1.92 x 0.90m, fieldstone 2m repeat. No embedded image, private atlas or new graph. One skyline draw; six textured draws. Separate POSITION/NORMAL streams and equal CPU/GPU geometry bytes. Each graph reads once per textured native run; unload releases geometry.

mediumFiReview.notes: Four authored LODs 260 / 1208 / 1836 / 2208 triangles; initial skyline+district geometry 135280 bytes, closeup 196720 bytes. Six GLBs zero Khronos errors/warnings; 190 actual mesh/contact probes and one intersecting detailed PMTiles case at level 15 (levels 13/14 have no intersecting building records in the extract). Inspected 52 current portable/shared/medium-fi/native frames. All LODs/failure/unload preserve 880 resident / 994 wider independent buildings, original 201x201/6m terrain/roads/289.053m² water and garden/approach ground. Failure keeps all 881 originals; unload restores ground/water and zero live geometry.

geographicReview.notes: Q276553 and named church way44890267/native35184416979099 establish the single owned building. Internal +X points east/slightly south toward the lower church; +Z south toward the photographed stair. Native east/up/south coordinates are baked with heading 0. Three construction volumes and local roof treatment are picture-led approximations from the mapped perimeter and photographs. Unrelated buildings remain independent. Only one owned parent is replaced; 880 resident / 994 wider independent buildings, roads and 289.053m² water remain. Exact historic terrain, paving, step levels and accessibility are unverified. Apse projection and unseen elevations are approximate. No bespoke terrain or flattening.

fidelityReview.notes: Picture-led medium-fi reconstruction: west annex eave 5.6m/ridge 6.7m, middle eave 6.3m/ridge 7.3m, lower east eave 3.8m with raised center gable to 6.3m, octagonal drum 7.0..9.0m and overhanging tiled cap to 9.9m; schematic cross reaches 10.5m. Source map height 5m and one level are unqualified controls, not survey. South landing/door threshold 3.05m, actual 0.35m recess, stair proportions reconstructed. Heights, inventories, north/east faces, roof junctions, exact paving/step levels are unverified. No authored historic frescoes or furnished rooms. An additional ordinary eastern exterior photo shows the rounded brick apse and curved roof crown. The source map simplifies this as a rectangle: the added 1.45m apse projection and its 3.55m wall/4.05m roof are picture-led approximations, not surveyed map geometry. Only the owned parent is replaced; the added apse has its own occupied ground mask. Upper doorway back uses shared dark painted metal; triangle and quad brick UVs now use the same metric repeat. Native fit is qualified: original coarse ground slopes about 1.4m across the rectangle and exposes the downhill foundation. Steps, upper doorway and inspected approach remain clear. Northern/other unseen elevations, roof junctions, internal subdivisions and architectural heights remain reconstructed; the apse projection is photograph-led and extends beyond the simplified mapped rectangle. Exact paving, step levels and accessibility are unverified. No copied frescoes, inscriptions, garden monuments or furnished rooms. Physical phone/laptop and dense-city timings remain pending.

frameReview.method: Actually inspected 52 current frames in nine labeled contact sheets plus final native south facade/stair, upper doorway, drum/roof and eastern apse/north wall at full resolution. Five ordinary pictures and standard PMTiles/Mapzen guided one continuous author/inspect/fix pass. Added the missing rounded apse and curved eastern roof crown, darkened the upper door, aligned triangle/quad brick UV repeats and closed roof/eave undersides after seeing a sky gap from below. No bespoke terrain research.

limitations: Principal connected Boyana Church exterior: stone western annex, taller brick middle bay with south exterior stair/raised door, lower eastern church with rounded apse and curved roof crown, red ceramic gables and octagonal tiled drum/cap/cross. Arched blind brickwork is raised framing over closed wall, with narrow dark window proxies. Upper door has an actual shallow recess, jambs, soffit, threshold and supported landing. Unseen northern/eastern elevations, internal subdivisions are conservative reconstructions. No fresco copies, furnished interior, garden monuments or surrounding buildings.
